name: Lifespan
overview: Scripture reveals that human life begins when God breathes the breath of life into man, making him a living soul, as seen in Genesis 2:7. The lifespan of individuals varied greatly, with early patriarchs like Adam living for many centuries (Genesis 5:4), but God later limited human life to 120 years as a consequence of human flesh and sin (Genesis 6:3). The Psalms reflect on the brevity and frailty of human life, noting that a typical lifespan is seventy to eighty years, marked by labor and sorrow (Psalm 90:10), yet God promises to satisfy the faithful with long life and salvation (Psalm 91:16).
